adventures.name: Snowman Shuffle
adventures.location: John A. Logan College, Carterville, Illinois + 2021 virtual completion
adventures.matchSource: User confirmation + River to River Runners historical calendars + 2021 virtual event record + Strava
adventures.note: A recurring Snowman Shuffle chapter spanning four in-person 5Ks at John A. Logan College in 2006–2009 and the 2021 virtual edition completed in Baltimore. The early editions predate the surviving Strava archive, so their event records are preserved separately from the 2021 personal GPS route.

adventures.name: River to River Relay
adventures.matchSource: Official River to River Relay results + historical course archive
adventures.note: Three editions of the classic Southern Illinois point-to-point relay: 2006 with Cambria Moonsnakes, 2008 with Team Swampass, and 2010 with Legion of Doom. The shared route is a historical full-course reference, not a personal GPS track.

adventures.name: Illinois Marathon Weekend
adventures.distance: Two race weekends · 5K + Marathon / Half Marathon
adventures.matchSource: Strava + Illinois Marathon weekend schedules + medal evidence
adventures.note: Two Illinois Marathon weekends: the 2015 5K plus full marathon I-Challenge and the 2016 5K plus half marathon Half I-Challenge.

adventures.name: RunDenver Series
adventures.note: Five races from the 2021–22 RunDenver winter series: Rudolph Ramble, Polar Bear, Super Bowl, Valentine's Day, and That Dam Run, with in-person and virtual completions kept distinct.

adventures.name: BOLDERBoulder
adventures.note: Four consecutive Memorial Day BOLDERBoulder 10Ks from 2022 through 2025, collected as one recurring race series while retaining each year's official result and personal GPS route.

adventures.name: COLDERBolder 5K
adventures.matchSource: Organizer archives + user confirmation + Strava GPS
adventures.note: Four consecutive COLDERBolder 5K editions from 2022 through 2025. The 2023 edition also served as the opening leg of the self-described Colorado Triathlon.

adventures.name: Denver Colfax Marathon Weekend
adventures.distance: Six races across four Colfax weekends
adventures.matchSource: Denver Colfax event archives + medals + Strava GPS
adventures.note: A recurring Colfax Marathon Weekend chapter spanning the 2021 Half Marathon, the 2024 5K and Urban 10 two-day challenge, the 2025 Marathon, and the 2026 5K and Urban 10 two-day challenge.

adventures.name: Heartland 39.3 Series
adventures.note: Three half marathons in five weeks: Rock the Parkway, Garmin Marathon in the Land of Oz Half, and Running With The Cows Half Marathon.

adventures.name: Illinois Half I-Challenge
adventures.note: Friday-night Illinois 5K followed by the Illinois Half Marathon the next morning.

adventures.name: Tennessee Pass Cross-Country Ski Weekend
adventures.location: Tennessee Pass Nordic Center, Leadville, Colorado
adventures.matchSource: Strava GPS export + GPS location reconstruction
adventures.note: A two-day cross-country ski weekend at Tennessee Pass Nordic Center outside Leadville. Back-to-back outings on January 2–3 totaled 15.00 miles and about 811 feet of climbing, turning the individual ski logs into one winter weekend story.

adventures.name: Ranch Hand
adventures.note: Two-day Snow Mountain Ranch Stampede challenge: 25K freestyle/skate on Saturday followed by 25K classic on Sunday.

adventures.name: DeCaLiBron
adventures.note: The classic DeCaLiBron loop linking Mount Democrat, Mount Cameron, Mount Lincoln, and Mount Bross in a single outing, completed with Alex's brother-in-law Ryan.
adventures.mediaIntro: DeCaLiBron was completed as a shared four-summit day with Alex's brother-in-law, Ryan.

adventures.name: Colorado Triathlon
adventures.note: Self-described three-leg Colorado Triathlon: COLDERBolder 5K, alpine skiing, then a mountain-bike ride, all on the same day.

adventures.name: Colorado Triathlon · Ski Leg
adventures.matchSource: Strava export + user-confirmed Colorado Triathlon context
adventures.note: Leg 2 of the self-described Colorado Triathlon: alpine skiing at Eldora between the COLDERBolder 5K and the North Table Mountain MTB leg.

adventures.name: Royal Gorge Groove Run + Ride Weekend
adventures.location: Royal Gorge Park, Cañon City, Colorado
adventures.matchSource: Strava + user memory + Royal Gorge Groove historical schedule
adventures.note: Back-to-back race weekend at Royal Gorge: a Saturday trail run followed by a Sunday mountain-bike race on the Royal Gorge trail system.

adventures.name: Kokopelli Trails Long Weekend
adventures.note: A long weekend built around three consecutive pedal-powered mountain-bike days on the Kokopelli trail system near Loma and Fruita. Across June 5–7, the rides totaled 27.51 miles and about 2,181 feet of climbing, turning three individual activity logs into one memorable Western Colorado trip.

adventures.name: Ski the Sky Loop
adventures.note: A stand-alone Big Sky ski objective around Lone Mountain: 14 recorded runs, 32.96 km, and 5,326 m of recorded descent.

adventures.name: West Maroon Pass Traverse
adventures.note: Two consecutive long hikes annotated West Maroon Pass (3,775 m) in the Strava export.
